### The Justice and Equity of David
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/justice-and-equity-of-david
Passage: 1 Chronicles 18:13-14
Points:
- David's military victories fulfilled God's promises by securing Israel's borders and collecting dedicated resources for the future temple.
- The ultimate source of David's triumphs was the Lord, who granted him victory wherever he went.
- In gratitude for God's sovereign favor, David governed his people with impartiality, equity, and justice.
- Christian leaders are called to mirror this pattern by leading the church justly according to the truth of Scripture.
